facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Monthly song-level opt-in (11th-last day of month, live the 1st of next month); auto-includes all track URIs/versions of a selected song
Eligibility: >=3 eligible songs, >=25,000 monthly listeners, >=20 streams per song in Discovery Mode contexts in the last 28 days, plus 30 days on platform

Release metadata rules: album/EP/single, <=4 main artists, full/split rights, no compilations/remasters/re-recordings/karaoke/soundalikes/white noise/spoken word; Artist Profile Protection approval; licensor allowlist (Amuse, CD Baby, CmdShft, DistroKid, EmuBands, EVEARA, Feiyr, Horus Music, LANDR, Lanzadera Music, MyMusic Sp, OFFstep, Rebeat Digital, recordJet, Repost Network, Soundrop, Stem, UnitedMasters, Venice Music, Vydia); no AI Persona badge
Cost: $0 cash; 30% commission on recording royalties from streams of selected songs in Discovery Mode contexts only, deducted from future statements
At a ~$3-$5 per 1,000 streams royalty baseline, 1,000 DM streams net ~$2.10-$3.50 vs. $3-$5

Key subtlety: the 30% commission applies to DM-context streams whether or not the algorithm would have served the track there anyway - tracks with existing Radio/Autoplay traffic pay a discount on listening they already had
Spotify claims: +50% saves, +44% playlist adds, +37% follows in the first month, and 31% of DM listeners brand-new to the artist
Spotify states it increases the likelihood of recommendation but does not guarantee it, and does not affect editorial playlists

Flywheel: boosted Radio/Autoplay exposure -> new listeners -> on-demand/catalog streams at full royalty (only DM-context streams take the 30% cut) -> stronger algorithmic profile; industry analyses estimate 100-400% stream lifts during active campaigns
The November 2025 'modern payola' class-action complaint alleges Discovery Mode's dynamic (Spotify monetizing its distribution bottleneck)
